artifact.note: The artifact is the model card the platform publishes and is checksum-addressed. This completion document is stored beside it and never inside it, so every previously published hash remains valid.

identity.name: Lettuce Earth growth · WUR gradient boosting

purpose: Second-generation lettuce fresh-mass regressor: the same task as v1 with a wider hyperparameter search and a documented selection rule.
intendedUse: As v1, with a more defensible model-selection record.
notIntendedFor: Operational or mission planning: fails its own independent check to the same criterion as v1.
Out-of-domain crops, cultivars or light regimes.

trainingData.hashBasis: SHA-256 of data/processed/lettuce_earth.csv exactly as committed. v2 reads the same table v1 writes, so the hash is shared with v1 and v3 by construction and not by copying; v3's artifact independently records the same value.
trainingData.reconstruction: python3 ml/training/train_lettuce.py regenerates the table; v2 then reads it.

split.method: Nested leave-one-experiment-out cross-validation (4 outer, 3 inner folds).
split.note: As v1: the fold boundary is the experiment, never the row.

uncertainty.statement: 90 % cross-conformal (CV+) interval, radius 91.20 g/plant, measured held-out coverage 0.961 over 4 calibration groups. The artifact itself notes the coverage is over-fitted to those four experiments and should be read as descriptive.

limitations: Only Batavia Othilie lettuce on Earth; not calibrated for partial gravity or radiation.
No inference for water stress, nutrient stress, CO2 response, other cultivars, or different photoperiods.
Measured domain is 2-29 days after transplant, air/root 20-32 C, PPFD 200-750 umol/m2/s; the treatment grid is sparse.
Environmental combinations omitted for tip burn are unsupported even inside marginal ranges.
Fresh shoot mass per plant is not edible harvest per square meter; no planting-density conversion is assumed.
Boosted trees extrapolate to a constant outside the training range; the out-of-domain flag is mandatory, not advisory.

outOfDomainBehaviour.mechanism: The artifact's `domain` block is enforced before scoring; a request outside it is refused with the field and range named rather than extrapolated, and a transcriptomic model rejects a partial expression vector instead of zero-filling.
